violation_type.title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children (26 TAC §744.3805(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Precautions for Loading and Unloading Children - Account for All Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver failed to account for all children or check off a roster list.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, a caregiver failed to account for all children or check off a roster list.

Based on evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support a caregiver failed to conduct name to face checks to account for all children when transitioning out of the van into the building.
Based on the information obtained during the DFPS investigation, the sign-in/out log did not accurately account for the children that were removed from the van and in the classroom.
It was determined that the driver did not account for all children at the time of unloading which resulted in a child being left on the vehicle.

During the course of a DFPS investigation, it was determined that multiple caregivers failed to demonstrate good judgement in the execution of their duties. The caregivers did not follow the operation's established protocol for accounting for children following a field trip.  They failed to do a count of children, did not conduct a name to face count, and failed to conduct a full walkthrough of the bus which resulted in a child being left on a bus alone for approximately 15 minutes.
Based on the evidence obtained during a DFPS investigation, a staff member did not correctly conduct checks of the transportation vehicle as required in the operation's safety plan.
